Yes. Monzo offers **arranged overdrafts of up to £2,000** on UK personal current accounts. You must be 18 or over, and the limit you’re offered depends on eligibility. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/overdrafts?utm_source=openai))

You pay interest **only on the amount you use**, not on the full limit. Monzo offers three variable effective annual rates: **19%, 29% or 39%**. Your rate depends on your credit score, and you can check it in the overdraft section of the Monzo app. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/overdrafts?utm_source=openai))

For example, at Monzo’s representative rate of 39%, borrowing **£1,200 for 30 days costs £32.94** in interest. Repaying sooner costs less. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/overdrafts?utm_source=openai))
